propositions: Continuous auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container during in-flight code reviews, causing the drain timeout (45s) to expire before review completion (260-911s), which cancels the worker and emits a fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote that blocks automatic backfill recovery.

The root cause is a constant mismatch: DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS (45) is far shorter than DEFAULT_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (1200), so the quiesce never completes a full review before the container terminates.

Transient git-fetch hangs (>300s observed in 2/25 runs) trigger review-error conditions that are incorrectly voted as fail-closed -1, making the change invisible to the backfill reconciler which skips any change with an existing vote.

When review completion is blocked by retryable conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled), the voter must post no vote and defer to the backfill reconciler, rather than casting a fail-closed -1 that prevents re-drive.

After a bounded number of consecutive retryable failures on the same revision (default 3), the voter must escalate by casting the fail-closed -1 with an escalation note and emitting VOTER_ERROR, preventing infinite retry loops.
Vote-less deferred changes must remain ineligible for submission and must not be suppressed by reconciler degraded modes, ensuring the backfill reconciler can re-drive them without side effects.
